Stale receipts confer nothing.

method: Source-first claim-by-claim review. The reviewer received a brief, neutral claims and the retained sources with labelled extractions, without the makers' assessments or earlier reviews, in eleven separate read-only runs. Each claim was split into atomic components with one verdict each; statements about the makers' own conduct were marked unassessed and do not by themselves lower an overall verdict. Every quoted passage was matched mechanically by the parent against the cited extraction or the retained original. Matching establishes text occurrence only. For version 0.5, a twelfth read-only run (17 October 2026) gave a new source-first finding on O24, whose qualification changed when the earlier ledger's unresolved Gartner value became known value K09, and checked for each other observation that its row is unchanged and that no change to the ledger or the catalogue (one source, S23, added) bears on its support; those 26 verdicts carry over, bound to the new catalogue digest.

quote_matching.note: The first pair counts the quoted passages of the 0.4 runs, O24's earlier receipt included; the second counts those of the run of 17 October 2026 (O24 and K09).
